item.title: SOG detains Sidhra resident over suspected cross-border contact
item.description: SUMIT SHARMA Jammu: In a significant security-related development, a team of the Special Operations Group (SOG), Jammu, on Thursday morning detained a resident of Sidhra for questioning in connection with suspected communication links across the border. Official sources said the SOG team reached the Sidhra area today morning and took one Muhammad Afzal into custody for further verification. item.title: Ladakh Freezes at –9.9°C as Sub-Zero Cold grips Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: Ladakh continued to reel under extreme cold conditions, emerging as the coldest region, while the Kashmir Valley recorded widespread sub-zero temperatures and the Jammu region experienced comparatively milder winter conditions. According to data compiled by Kashmir Weather, Drass recorded the lowest minimum temperature at minus 9.9 degrees Celsius. item.title: Shab-e-Meraj celebrated across Kashmir valley
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: Shab-e-Meraj was observed across the Kashmir Valley on Friday night, with night-long prayers held in mosques and shrines despite the ongoing Chillai–Kalan, the 40-day period of the harshest winter in the region. Devotees gathered at various places of worship to offer special prayers seeking peace, prosperity, and forgiveness. item.description: Srinagar,Jan 17: The Jammu-Srinagar National Highway is open for two-way traffic on Saturday however, heavy congestion was reported at several places along the vital arterial road, causing inconvenience to commuters. item.title: Jammu Kashmir: 45-year-old Woman found tied in Plastic Bag, critical

item.title: Rain, Snow likely across Jammu Kashmir, Heavy spell forecast in higher reaches
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 19: A prolonged wet spell is expected to affect Jammu and Kashmir from January 19 to January 25, with generally cloudy conditions and intermittent light rain and snow at many places, the MET Centre Srinagar said on Monday. item.title: Kashmir continues to Freeze as IMD predicts Snowfall, Rainfall
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 20: Minimum temperatures across Kashmir plunged below the freezing mark at most locations, with Sonamarg emerging as the coldest place in the Valley at minus 6.2 degrees Celsius, according to data compiled by Kashmir Weather. Srinagar recorded a minimum temperature of minus 3.4 degrees Celsius, while the mercury at Srinagar airport dropped to minus 4.4 degrees.
